import numpy as np

# --- Reasoning ---
# Hammer lies along Y (handle +Y, head -Y). Keep it in that orientation for the handover:
# both arms grasp the handle from above with grippers opening along X (perpendicular to handle),
# offset along Y so the two gripper bodies are ~9cm apart. Arm0 takes the +Y (tip) side of the
# handle, Arm1 takes the -Y side (still on the handle, away from the head).
# Handover at x midpoint (~0.81) with hammer z = 0.175 (within 0.15-0.20).
# Movements are decomposed: vertical lift, horizontal translation, vertical descent.

Q0_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])    # arm0 down, opening along X
Q1_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, -0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm1 down, opening along X

hpos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(hpos[0]), float(hpos[1]), float(hpos[2])

GRASP_OFF_A0 = 0.045   # arm0 grasp point toward handle tip (+Y)
GRASP_OFF_A1 = -0.045  # arm1 grasp point toward head side but still on handle (-Y)
X_MID = 0.81
Z_HANDOVER = 0.175
Z_LIFT = max(hz + 0.15, Z_HANDOVER + 0.10)

open_gripper_arm0()
open_gripper_arm1()

# --- Arm0: approach and grasp hammer handle ---
grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, hz])
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([hx, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, hz + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.08)
close_gripper_arm0()

# --- Arm0: lift vertically, then translate to handover point, then set handover height ---
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([hx, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, Z_LIFT]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([X_MID, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, Z_LIFT]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([X_MID, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, Z_HANDOVER]), Q0_DOWN_X)

# --- Arm1: approach from above on the other side of the handle (9cm apart in Y from arm0) ---
grasp1 = np.array([X_MID, hy + GRASP_OFF_A1, Z_HANDOVER])
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([X_MID, hy + GRASP_OFF_A1, Z_HANDOVER + 0.15]), Q1_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm1(grasp1, Q1_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.08)
close_gripper_arm1()

# --- Arm0 releases and retreats (up first, then back toward its own side) ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([X_MID, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, Z_HANDOVER + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.45, hy + GRASP_OFF_A0, Z_HANDOVER + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
